drafts.subject: Invoice CBF-1401 (PO 4500012166) - request for corrected tax invoice
drafts.body:
Hello,

Thank you for invoice CBF-1401 dated 22 September 2026 against our purchase order 4500012166, with a total of $3,151.50 including GST.

During our review we noticed that GST appears to have been charged on line 1, International sea freight - Ningbo to Melbourne, 20ft, which we understand to be GST-free. Based on the taxable amount of $385.00, we would expect GST of $38.50 (10%). The invoice shows GST of $286.50, which is $248.00 higher than expected.

Could you please review this and send us a corrected tax invoice showing the correct GST amount? If you believe the GST as charged is correct, please let us know the basis so we can review it on our side.

We will process payment once the corrected invoice has been received. Please quote invoice number CBF-1401 and PO 4500012166 in your reply.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable, Corio Packaging
